categories.description: A distribution the trustee MUST make — fixed amounts, income distributions, or payments required at stated dates, ages, or events, with no discretion.
categories.name: Mandatory Distribution

categories.description: A provision permitting or restricting transactions between the trustee and the trust — loans to trustees, purchases of trust property, or trustee interests in trust investments.
categories.name: Self-Dealing / Conflict

categories.description: A power exercisable only with the consent of a protector, co-trustee, beneficiary, or other third party — and the powers reserved to the protector.
categories.name: Protector / Consent Requirement

categories.description: A distribution or vesting triggered by a beneficiary reaching a stated age or by a stated event — staged distributions, contingent gifts, or postponement powers.
categories.name: Age / Event Contingency

categories.description: A power to distribute income or capital at the trustee's discretion — including any standard that guides it (health, education, maintenance, support) and the class it serves.
categories.name: Discretionary Distribution Power

categories.description: A restriction or direction on how trust assets may be invested, a duty to diversify or retain, or limits on delegating investment decisions.
categories.name: Investment Power / Restriction

categories.description: When and how the trust ends — perpetuity or vesting dates, termination powers, and the final distribution scheme.
categories.name: Termination / Vesting

categories.description: A duty to account or report to beneficiaries or others — what must be provided, to whom, and how often.
categories.name: Accounting / Reporting Duty

categories.description: A clause limiting trustee liability or indemnifying the trustee from trust assets, and its carve-outs.
categories.name: Trustee Exculpation / Indemnity

categories.description: A power to appoint trust property among a class, add or remove beneficiaries, or vary the trusts.
categories.name: Power of Appointment

categories.description: The trustee's right to remuneration, charging clauses, or fee arrangements.
categories.name: Trustee Remuneration

categories.description: A restraint on a beneficiary assigning or encumbering their interest, or protecting it from creditors.
categories.name: Spendthrift / Anti-Alienation

categories.description: The governing law of the trust and any power to change it or move the trust's situs.
categories.name: Governing Law

document_types.description: Deeds of variation, amendment, or rectification altering the trust's terms.
document_types.name: Amendments / Variations

document_types.description: Deeds appointing, removing, or retiring trustees, or accepting office.
document_types.name: Trustee Appointments / Retirements

document_types.description: Deeds exercising a power of appointment or advancement over trust property.
document_types.name: Deeds of Appointment / Advancement

document_types.description: The settlor's letter of wishes or memorandum of guidance to the trustees.
document_types.name: Letter of Wishes

document_types.description: Trustee resolutions, minutes, or records approving or making distributions.
document_types.name: Distribution Resolutions / Records

document_types.description: Investment policy statements, management agreements, or delegation instruments.
document_types.name: Investment Policy / Management

document_types.description: Trust accounts, financial statements, or tax filings for the trust.
document_types.name: Trust Accounts

document_types.description: Letters, notices, or consents to or from beneficiaries.
document_types.name: Beneficiary Correspondence

document_types.description: Instruments appointing a protector or recording the exercise of protector powers.
document_types.name: Protector Documents
